headline: India Rice Export Prices Touch 19-Month High on African Demand and Rupee
summary: Indian rice export prices climbed to their highest level in over 19 months, supported by rupee strength and solid import demand from African buyers, while Thai rates also rose.
why: India is the world's top rice exporter; moves in its export benchmark directly affect global food security, staple grain indices, and emerging market import bills.

impacts.name: Global Rice Trade
impacts.why: Strong export demand and currency strength pushed benchmark export quotes to 19-month highs.
